claims.claim: A stage that returns an error ends the turn; ExecuteSync returns it with a result holding what was emitted before the failure, and a nil result only when the pipeline could not start
A stage returning an error without emitting it arrives as *stage.StageError (StageName, StageType, Err)
The provider stage emits its own error, so provider failures reach ExecuteSync callers as the provider error, not a *StageError
stage.ErrMaxRoundsExceeded is returned when the tool loop reaches its round limit
providers.IsTransient is true for 429/502/503/504 and connection failures, false for context errors and stream idle timeouts
Execute returns an error only when it cannot start (ErrPipelineShuttingDown); failures arrive as the last output element
WithExecutionTimeout is disabled by default; WithIdleTimeout defaults to 30 seconds
ExecutionTimeout expiry fails the running stage with context.DeadlineExceeded
ErrTemplateUnresolved fails the turn when a system prompt variable is unsupplied
Page snippets (send, classify, sendWithRetry, sendWithFallback, stream) compile and behave as described against mock provider
